spans.s: (onomat. बिबिबा + pr. p. cf. √ भू) crackling, MaitrS.

etym.s: fr. Desid. of Caus. of √ बुध्

spans.s: wishing to rouse, intending to wake, R. (cf. बुबोधयिषु).
(also written विव्वोक, or विब्बोक) haughty indifference, L.
(in erotic poetry) affectation of indifference towards a beloved object through pride and conceit, Śiś. viii, 29; Sāh.
